Package org.praxisplatform.uischema.annotation

Annotation Interface VerifiedAnalyticalRecipe

@Documented @Target({TYPE,METHOD}) @Retention(RUNTIME) @Repeatable(VerifiedAnalyticalRecipes.class) public @interface VerifiedAnalyticalRecipe
Declares a governed, server-verified analytical recipe on a Praxis resource controller.

A @VerifiedAnalyticalRecipe anchors statistical semantics (operation, grouping field or dimensions, metric, locked filter criteria, and bounded adjustable parameters) in backend code rather than leaving AI agents or clients to assemble ad hoc aggregations. Published automatically via x-ui.analytics.verifiedRecipes, /schemas/domain, GET /stats/recipes, and executed fail-closed via POST /stats/recipes/{recipeId}.
